source: Schneider Electric case studies (se.com) — each evidence line individually re-verified against live se.com case study pages on this date, not just carried forward. 2026-09-24: rewrote several `evidence` strings that had internal audit/QA notes (e.g. 'flag to a real audit before citing to a client', 'savingRange is null') baked into the client-facing text itself — those were meant as authoring notes, not copy, and were being rendered verbatim in the Products section of the results page. Underlying facts unchanged; only the unverified Chew's Agriculture ~50% figure was dropped rather than kept caveated, since a hedge belongs in an internal note, not in front of a client.
appliesToNote: appliesTo is descriptive context only — actual recommendation triggers in products.ts/mncProducts.ts are capability-based (has a generator, onsite solar, stationary fuel, etc.), not sector-restricted. This is deliberate: the Validation Report's signed-off scenarios show EBO recommended as primary across Retail/Office/Manufacturing/Hospitality/Logistics, and Microgrid/EaaS across Manufacturing/Hospitality/Logistics — i.e. every sector that trips the capability trigger, regardless of appliesTo. Do not gate recommendations on this field; it would contradict validated behavior.

products.name: EcoStruxure Building Operation (EBO)
